name: ema61_breakout/monthly_weekly_stop_macd_pattern_rank_nifty200
description: Monthly EMA61 breakout, entry only when weekly and daily closes are above EMA61; stop at previous week's low (fixed). No new entries while NIFTY 50 is below its 200-day average (Sensex before mid-2008). Competing signals ranked by MACD + pattern score (monthly MACD histogram rising +1, rising below zero +1, weekly bullish TA-Lib pattern in the last 2 weeks +1); ties by tightest stop.
